description: Query recorded scalar channels at explicit time with declared gap, interpolation and value-mapping policies.
output_invariants: One detached finite value per mapping, in input mapping order. Input arrays/records never mutate; no retained state, aliases or partial output. All exposed zeros are +0.

behavior.validation: Required exact own string keys on passive ordinary/null-prototype records; dense ordinary arrays with own data slots only, no extra/symbol properties or accessors. Proxies outside interchange. Every numeric value finite; arrays <=2147483647 elements. Times strictly increasing nonnegative, channels unique ASCII identifiers matching schema, sample row count equals time count, each row length equals channel count. Mappings refer to existing channels, domain[0]<domain[1], range may ascend, descend or be constant. Validate every field in schema order, and every value even for unused channels, before work. No coercion or defaults.
behavior.work: Let T=times.length,C=channels.length,M=mappings.length. Reserve exact integer T*C+M after complete static validation; WORK_LIMIT if above maxWork or safe integer. This counts sample/mapping events, not every validation instruction. Time O(T*C+M+log T), retained scratch O(T*C+M) at most. No cross-call cache or allocation guarantee.
behavior.query: Hold first row for time<=times[0] and last for time>=times[T-1]. Otherwise find largest i with times[i]<=time. Exact knot returns that row. Strict interior computes gap=times[i+1]-times[i]; gap>maxGap throws TIME_GAP before any mapping, including STEP. Each mapping uses its own source channel. STEP chooses row i. LINEAR computes q=(time-times[i])/gap; v=left+q*(right-left) in that order. Exact knots and endpoint holds skip interpolation only. STEP is right-continuous at knots.
behavior.mapping: For each mapping in order: delta=v-domain[0]; span=domain[1]-domain[0]; n=delta/span; when clamp=true replace n with min(1,max(0,n)); extent=range[1]-range[0]; scaled=n*extent; result=range[0]+scaled. Do not bypass any of these primitives at exact endpoints or constant ranges. Independent mappings may reuse a channel.
behavior.numerics: Separate ordered IEEE754 binary64 primitives, no fused operations or algebraic reassociation. Finite-check every computed primitive before continuing/clamping; NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite result, including intermediate subtractions. Underflow to zero is permitted. No epsilon in time/gap decisions. Exact shared numeric outputs; canonicalize exposed -0.
behavior.environment: No media, FFT/RMS extraction, renderer, font, RNG, clock, frame, host callback or retained state. Query time and data are explicit.
behavior.native_surface: sampleRecordedControls(input), SampleRecordedControlsError with stable code. Initial implementation target p5.js package; other targets deferred.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Malformed carrier, dimensions, identifier, time ordering, domain or scalar.
errors.WORK_LIMIT: Exact T*C+M exceeds maxWork or portable safe-integer work.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Specified binary64 primitive yields nonfinite value.
